name: Retail Sales
consensus_source: Trading Economics report on the September 2026 release (2026-10-15), forecast 0.3% m/m, underlying survey not named
read: Headline +0.77% m/m vs 0.3% consensus (beat), after +1.29% in August. Gas stations +6.4% on price drove it; ex-gas only +0.2%. Real consumption signal is softer than headline. Supports nominal GDP, adds to inflation pressure.
